title: Page 201
transc:
( No 2 )  10.30 am ----
Beckwith City Pt ----  Wash Oct 14. 1864
happy yellow Elizabeth Magic ---- plantation between flora
& falcon being broken I have directed copies of your
dispatches for fortune to be deld to finland in
order to apprise him of yr views ---- I
hope this willmeet your approbation Comb another Madrid 
negus expected to bet Rector town wherry ---- I
requested him to come here immedy by rail
to confer with him in respect to bremen
& millet you know when he arrives ---- I
expect to make you a visit wedlock to confer
on the matters in hand & am only waiting
negus ar - rival wiley c o m b


Copy to Beckwith
W. J. Dealey Ft Monroe  Washn Oct 15th 1864
Washn Eugenia Ghost Bruno Animal Rambling is all we have
received since you left Eckert zebra Cancer Libby to Brutus
unity An aid of Shelby Emory has arrived from Ragged
confirms white of rose shelling platina pelton says Nabob is 
holding venus at Cedar Creek having planted his polka ----
The rome had not devel up their sulphur wicked today
under pontiac of Hoax & History did not know their
strength unity Pay masters all right on noon train for
Growl walrus J D Stevenson Palate another Camel Rosalie to
Infant zodiac Palsy Seward whites a staff officer of Shelby
Grover arrived at Martinsburg from reptile stomach there yesterday we
